'''Laila Lewin's infant''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident. It was born to [[Natley Lewin]] and [[Laila Lewin]] in {{ne|998}} or, more likely, {{ne|999}}.{{ref|When Perrin visited the al'Seen farm in {{ne|999|Amadaine}}, the infant was in swaddling.{{ref/book|4|32}}}}

== Activities ==
[[Laila]] was holding the infant while at [[Jac al'Seen]]'s farm when [[Perrin]] visited with [[Faile]]. While emphasizing the dangers of remaining on the farm, Perrin used the infant as an example of something the [[Trolloc]]s could destroy that couldn't be rebuilt.{{ref/book|4|32}}

== In the television series ==
In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]], {{PAGENAME}} does not exist.
